channel.title: Midnight blog - en - Last 7 days
channel.description: 记录软件从需求、架构设计、开发、测试到发布、运维与持续改进的工程实践，讨论具体约束、方案取舍和验证方法。AI 是工具链的一部分。 | Language: en | Range: Last 7 days

item.title: Why can a long loop still block inside requestIdleCallback?
item.description: Use a four-item queue to explain cooperative idle budgets, separating an unexecuted page from an executed timeout-policy fixture.

item.title: How can a selected CTest test bring its setup and cleanup along?
item.description: Verify fixture setup and cleanup added for selected consumers, including failed preparation and independent logs.

item.title: Why do files written to a writable RUN bind mount vanish in the next step?
item.description: Verify RUN bind-write lifetime with separate output paths, a read-only failure, and a stage-source control.

item.title: How can check-ignore explain a rule match for an already-tracked file?
item.description: Diagnose ignore patterns separately from index state, including verbose negated-pattern output.

item.title: Why does Base64 Strict still accept a newline?
item.description: Check valid bits, invalid bits, CRLF and unpadded forms against the precise Strict contract in an unexecuted Go fixture.

item.title: Why does O_CREATE leave the old suffix after a shorter write?
item.description: Distinguish creation, overwriting, truncation and append with independent full-content oracles in an unexecuted Go fixture.

item.title: Why does Read start at ab after ReadAt returned cd?
item.description: Separate offset reads, sequential progress and explicit Seek with interleaved byte and short-read oracles; Go fixture unexecuted.

item.title: Why can inputs remain outside a form after their fieldset gets a form attribute?
item.description: Inspect the owners of an external fieldset and its inputs, then test an unmatched explicit form override inside a form.

item.title: HTTP 414: why can a long query still fail after the body is emptied?
item.description: Compare three local ASCII-target cases, distinguish URI length from content capacity, and identify evidence needed for repeated 414 responses.

item.title: Why does a JSON reviver visit children before their parent?
item.description: Trace child deletion and the parent snapshot, then inspect a new array-index case without confusing deletion with compaction.

item.title: Why can a String.raw result still contain an actual newline?
item.description: Compare literal segments and evaluated substitutions by exact code units, then inspect an ordinary call with fewer substitutions.

item.title: Why can a stored string still fail isWellFormed?
item.description: Inspect lone and paired UTF-16 surrogates by exact units, distinguish replacement from recovery, and test a new URI-encoding consumer.

item.title: Why does an updated image not start a rollout while a Deployment is paused?
item.description: Correlate paused template edits with the resumed rollout identity; the cluster fixture is unrun.

item.title: Why can AP differ from trapezoidal area on the same PR curve?
item.description: Derive AP of 5/6 and trapezoidal area of 19/24 from three ranked examples, then inspect a separate tied-score condition.

item.title: How can you restore a monkeypatch before the test ends?
item.description: Restore scoped patches before teardown and verify normal, exceptional, and nested-owner behavior.

item.title: Why does ^ still use the original string origin in a fullmatch window?
item.description: Check original spans, sliced spans and real-newline controls to distinguish bounded matching from a new string origin.

item.title: Why does redirect_stdout capture another thread too?
item.description: Separate global capture, restoration and explicit streams with a controlled joined worker and an independent stderr check.

item.title: Why can casefold match Straße when lower cannot?
item.description: Separate caseless matching from original-text highlighting using expansion, offset and canonical-composition controls.

item.title: Why is a ZINTER score eight when the inputs were one and two?
item.description: Use independent integer oracles and a reversed-order control to explain weighting before aggregation; Redis commands unexecuted.

item.title: Does RestartPreventExitStatus turn a failed exit into success?
item.description: Separate restart prevention from successful-exit classification with two same-exit fixtures; Linux execution remains unrun.

item.title: Why can validate_only succeed while the resource remains unchanged?
item.description: Compare equal success responses with different stored states and retain permission checks, request mode, and later reads.

item.title: Why does a mute toggle keep the Mute label when aria-pressed changes?
item.description: Compare a stable Mute label with pressed and teaching mute states, and distinguish that design from changing action labels.

item.title: Why can a pointer-events:none ancestor still observe its child’s click?
item.description: Distinguish an auto child hit from its ancestor event path, with capture and bubble logs and two physical click locations.

item.title: How can CTest give the active phase its own timeout after waiting?
item.description: Verify a CTest timeout transition with fast, slow, and unmatched branches, preserving failed preflight assumptions.

item.title: How can Docker ADD verify the expected content after a remote download?
item.description: Pin an approved digest, exercise matching and one-character-wrong builds, and verify exported bytes beyond download success.

item.title: Why can Git report LF while the working file contains CRLF?
item.description: Read index and disk bytes independently to interpret Git EOL content fields and conversion attributes.

item.title: Why does Marshal sort map keys despite varying iteration order?
item.description: Check ordinary map encoding against a fixed text oracle, including integer-to-string key conversion.

item.title: Why does a map keep two Time keys for the same instant?
item.description: Compare Equal, structural equality, and normalized map keys for two location representations of one instant.

item.title: Why can setRangeText produce the same text with different selections?
item.description: Compare three selection modes for one replacement and retain the text plus both endpoints before the next editing action.

item.title: Why can a new defineProperty value resist writes and disappear from key lists?
item.description: Compare new descriptor and literal properties through values, flags, keys, and writes, with creation and update treated under their own conditions.

item.title: Why do separator digits appear after splitting with a capturing regex?
item.description: Compare capturing and noncapturing split results, count captures against the limit, and inspect an unmatched capture.

item.title: Why can old ReplicaSets remain with revisionHistoryLimit zero?
item.description: Check current Deployment completion before interpreting zero history and remaining ReplicaSets; cluster execution is unrun.

item.title: Why can constant targets make the default R² score only zero or one?
item.description: Explain non-finite constant-target R² through SSE and SST, retain the replacement parameter, and compare a finite zero.

item.title: How do you tell pytest to test an installed package by name?
item.description: Run pytest by package name outside its checkout and verify interpreter, installation origin, and collected tests.

item.title: Why did the second hash include the first suffix?
item.description: Check copied prefix branches against complete byte inputs, an alias contamination control, and a later update after digest observation.

item.title: Why does heapreplace evict the old minimum for an even smaller input?
item.description: Compare returned and retained values for two incoming scores, then verify the empty-heap startup condition.

item.title: Why has product consumed its input before the first output?
item.description: Observe a finite source at construction and first-read boundaries, then distinguish zero axes from one empty axis.

item.title: Why does unpack reject a complete frame larger than its two-byte header?
item.description: Compare exact and offset header decoding, a short header, payload boundaries, and incomplete fixed records.

item.title: Why does a reverse LPOS search still return a head-based index?
item.description: Compare occurrence rank, head-based positions, reverse result order, and a limited MAXLEN search.

item.title: Where can a systemd service write state with ProtectSystem=strict?
item.description: Keep necessary state writes in a managed directory and check an EROFS control with the same identity; Linux execution remains unrun.

item.title: Why does AIP-160 group OR first in a AND b OR c?
item.description: Use eight Boolean rows to explain AIP filter precedence and distinguish matching results from a correct grammar implementation.

item.title: Why does a thicker outline leave the neighboring button in place?
item.description: Separate outline ink from layout space and compare target geometry, neighbor position, and the rendered indicator.

item.title: How can CTest keep two tests off the same device during a parallel run?
item.description: Verify a named CTest resource lock using an atomic marker and execution intervals, with explicit scope boundaries.

item.title: How can one Docker COPY exclude a file while another still includes it?
item.description: Export full and reduced file sets from one context to verify per-instruction Docker COPY exclusion and required contents.

item.title: Why can normalize detach a Text reference while leaving the text unchanged?
item.description: Trace three Text nodes becoming one while the content stays AB, and inspect what saved references represent afterward.

item.title: How can Git compare two exports outside a repository?
item.description: Compare two exports outside a repository and interpret patch, diagnostics, and status using an observed missing-path result.

item.title: Why does a CSV Reader reject the second row's field count?
item.description: Compare inferred, explicit, and permissive CSV widths and trace the first record's effect on later rows.

item.title: Why does Trim remove letters when I only wanted to remove .zip?
item.description: Compare cutset trimming with literal prefix and suffix removal and protect the complete filename body.

item.title: Why does copyWithin avoid turning an overlapping right shift into all A values?
item.description: Compare AABC with an incorrect AAAA result and check overlap direction, array identity, length, and the overwrite contract.

item.title: Why does padStart use aba when three padding units are needed?
item.description: Explain aba7 through the repeated filler prefix, compare short and overlong inputs, and define the role of a display identifier.

item.title: Why can an entrypoint miss configuration created by PostStart?
item.description: Compare concurrent PostStart preparation with an ordered entrypoint and verify the application's first configuration read.

item.title: Why can GroupShuffleSplit with test_size=0.5 test more or fewer than half the rows?
item.description: Distinguish group proportions from row proportions with four groups and twelve rows, and inspect split intersections and counts.

item.title: Why can pytest run tests outside configured testpaths?
item.description: Compare pytest's default search roots with an explicit test path and retain the actual node identities.

item.title: Why does decompressing concatenated gzip data return both payloads?
item.description: Check independent members, their concatenation, a corrupted second CRC, and the condition for a single-member zlib alternative.

item.title: Why does accumulate return three balances for two transactions?
item.description: Check opening and post-event states, then reproduce a shifted zip that silently drops the last balance.

item.title: Why can a caller override a timeout bound by partial?
item.description: Compare keyword overrides, positional collisions, and mutation of stored configuration at the underlying function.

item.title: Why can SRANDMEMBER return A three times from a set?
item.description: Use exact single-member replies and multi-member invariants to check signed counts, repetition, and source state.

item.title: Why does changes return one when a trigger wrote two more rows?
item.description: Check one direct INSERT, two trigger audit rows, and their state after rollback in an isolated SQLite transaction.

item.title: Why can a service and the host see different files at the same tmp path?
item.description: Read distinct temporary markers from host and service views to explain PrivateTmp visibility and cleanup boundaries.

item.title: Why must motion actuation be disableable even when an Undo button exists?
item.description: Use four undo-state cases to check an alternative control and disableable motion response, then scope the essential-motion condition.

item.title: Why can content stay hidden when aria-expanded becomes true?
item.description: Keep a button’s expanded state in sync with its panel. Test opening, closing, reopening, and restoring state.

item.title: Why can break-word and anywhere yield different intrinsic widths?
item.description: Compare one token under two wrapping values and separate visible line breaks from intrinsic sizing.

item.title: Why can CTest fail a process that returns zero?
item.description: Compare CTest's inverted and ordinary normal-exit rules, then verify the identity of a negative test's rejection.

item.title: How can Docker COPY preserve parent paths from several directories?
item.description: Compare ordinary and parent-preserving Docker COPY exports with content and absence checks at the consumer's expected paths.

item.title: How can you isolate the resolution in a Git merge commit?
item.description: Compare a Git remerge view, first-parent diff, and committed file to inspect a two-parent conflict resolution.

item.title: Does an empty Scanner.Text mean EOF?
item.description: Compare blank lines, empty input, and an unterminated final line to detect early termination of a Scanner loop.

item.title: Why does Go add one month to October 31 and land on December 1?
item.description: Compare UTC timestamp oracles for AddDate normalization, an explicit month-end clamp, and a reverse calendar change.

item.title: Why do same-name details in separate sections close each other?
item.description: Use four details elements to test local exclusion and independence across sections. Check the scope of a shared name in one tree.

item.title: Why is zero not a placeholder for Content-Length after 411?
item.description: Use three fixed bytes to distinguish a missing length, zero, and a valid count, with local checks kept separate from upload completion.

item.title: Why does at(-0.5) read the first item instead of the last?
item.description: Compare negative integers, fractions, and out-of-range positions on one three-item array. Check conversion before inspecting the returned row.

item.title: Why can Promise.resolve(load()) miss a synchronous throw?
item.description: Locate a synchronous throw before or inside an adapter. Use a fixed error and event list to test Promise.try invocation and reaction timing.

item.title: Why can a CronJob skip a Job after a one-minute delay?
item.description: Compare a CronJob's scheduled time with its controller check to explain a missed occurrence under thirty- and ninety-second windows.

item.title: Why can micro precision be 80% while macro is below 45%?
item.description: Compute two precision averages from a fixed nine-to-one example and retain class denominators to expose the minority-class failure.

item.title: Why does bisect with a key still reject a whole search record?
item.description: Check probe types, tied-score boundaries, and inserted record identity across bisect and insort.

item.title: Why did dataclasses.asdict replace the field object too?
item.description: Use list mutations and a nested owner to compare recursive dataclass conversion with a shallow fields/getattr projection.

item.title: Why does a full deque accept append but reject insert?
item.description: Compare endpoint additions, indexed insertion, and a left-side batch on independent bounded deques.

item.title: Why does isclose still reject a tiny residual against zero?
item.description: Check signed residuals on both sides of an absolute bound, then verify isclose's special-value behavior.

item.title: How can unittest release registered resources before the test ends?
item.description: Verify early cleanup, a repeated drain, and newly registered callbacks with a two-phase unittest event sequence.

item.title: Why can SQLite integrity_check return ok with an orphan row?
item.description: Compare structural success with a foreign-key violation in an isolated database, then verify the repaired relationship and preserved child.

item.title: Why can a service exceed MemoryHigh without being killed immediately?
item.description: Distinguish systemd reclaim pressure from the hard memory limit and inspect effective values alongside cgroup events.

item.title: Why remove aria-sort from the old header after changing columns?
item.description: Sort a table by name and count, then check the row order, active direction, and previous header after switching columns.

item.title: Which stage does Buildx select by default in this Dockerfile?
item.description: Inspect the default Buildx stage and compare it with an explicit target using two fresh local exports.

item.title: Why can a newly inserted notice appear without fading in?
item.description: Insert two notices with the same ordinary opacity. Compare entry starting styles and verify that the feedback stays visible with reduced motion.

item.title: Why did CTest show a skip after the test process exited nonzero?
item.description: Use three isolated process outcomes to distinguish passed, skipped, and failed CTest runs and verify required coverage.

item.title: Can Git recognize the same patch when its files arrive in a different order?
item.description: Swap complete Git file diffs and introduce an actual edit to see when stable and unstable patch IDs differ.

item.title: Did strings.Cut see an equals sign if the value was empty?
item.description: Use four configuration lines to distinguish an empty right side from a missing separator and preserve inheritance, clearing, and assignment.

item.title: Why didn't sync.Once.Do retry after a panic?
item.description: Use an attempt count, configuration state, and a fresh-instance control to separate Once behavior after a panic from retries owned by the application.

item.title: Does HTTP 300 make a client jump to one URL?
item.description: Compare web and print alternatives to see how HTTP 300 offers representations, indicates a preference, and supports a client’s choice.

item.title: Is HTTP 408 the same as a client-side timeout?
item.description: Compare an observed 408 response with an expired client deadline. Distinguish the server receiving a request from a client waiting for a response.

item.title: Why can instanceof Array reject an array from another realm?
item.description: Compare arrays containing the same rows across JavaScript realms. Inspect the difference between instanceof and the Array.isArray type check.

item.title: How can a regex search treat the plus in A+B literally?
item.description: Compare raw and escaped patterns using A+B and AAAB. Check which full document titles each pattern matches.

item.title: Why can a Pending Pod avoid scheduling even when nodes are free?
item.description: Compare gated and ungated Kubernetes Pods, and verify gate release, node assignment, and application readiness independently.

item.title: Why can mean confidence match accuracy without calibration?
item.description: Use eight classification predictions to compare confidence with accuracy within each bin, then calculate ECE using sample weights.

item.title: Why did moving the same assertion into a helper leave pytest with a bare AssertionError?
item.description: Keep the failure fixed and compare pytest assertion diagnostics before and after registering an imported helper.

item.title: How did a Semaphore initialized with one permit admit two acquires?
item.description: Compare plain and bounded asyncio semaphores to see how an extra release affects capacity and how to assign cleanup around cancellation.

item.title: Why did the shortage disappear from Counter subtraction?
item.description: Compare two inventory calculations to see which Counter operation preserves signed balances, explicit zeros, and the original snapshot.

item.title: Why does EJECT return an int for an unknown flag bit?
item.description: Compare four FlagBoundary policies on the same integer. Check the retained bits and the type each constructor returns.

item.title: Why did testzip() return None for a ZIP missing its manifest?
item.description: Use intact, corrupted, and missing-manifest ZIPs to compare testzip(), required names, and format identification.

item.title: Why did ZPOPMIN return one member and remove the key?
item.description: Compare a read and two pops on a disposable sorted set. Check the return count, member order, and key state after the last pop.

item.title: Why can a systemd service still run after its main process exits?
item.description: Compare the main and cgroup lifetime rules in systemd using the same parent and child processes, then verify application delivery separately.

item.title: How can a quality slider describe position 2 as Standard?
item.description: Use a native three-position slider to check that the numeric position, visible preset, and aria-valuetext stay in sync.

item.title: Which of the two Buildx metadata digests identifies the image output?
item.description: Trace the Buildx output descriptor and its OCI manifest configuration reference, then verify both digests against the local archive.

item.title: Why did a full CMake install omit this component?
item.description: Use three fresh CMake installation prefixes to check what a full install and two component installs actually deliver.

item.title: How can a fixed-width textarea grow with its content?
item.description: Compare fixed and content on equally wide textareas. Measure how a longer value changes height and inspect any layout constraints.

item.title: Why can a focused button fail to match :focus-visible?
item.description: Use Tab and a pointer click on the same button. Compare its active element, selector matches, and visible focus indicator.

item.title: Why can Git diff --check pass with uncommitted changes?
item.description: Compare three states in a small Git repository to distinguish patch policy from the presence of differences in a release check.

item.title: Why did Go CopyN write bytes even though it failed?
item.description: Compare a complete Go transfer with a short source and verify what would remain in the destination.

item.title: After HTTP 413, should the client shrink the file or wait?
item.description: The same file can exceed a standing or a temporary size limit. Use a local comparison to decide when to change the content or check the wait condition.

item.title: Why can a bilingual document carry one Content-Language tag?
item.description: Use a French quote in an English tutorial to check intended audience and local language independently in Content-Language and HTML lang.

item.title: How do you link only the names in a localized list?
item.description: Use two locales to compare list parts, placing links around names while preserving the punctuation and conjunctions supplied by the formatter.

item.title: Do running Pods wait in place when a Kubernetes Job is suspended?
item.description: Compare Job and Pod UIDs across Kubernetes suspension and resumption, and verify application progress separately.

item.title: Why can two A votes choose different answers?
item.description: Map A and B votes back to candidate IDs after swapping presentation order. Distinguish stable preferences, explicit ties, and inconsistent results.

item.title: Why can switching PostgreSQL regex functions remove unmatched rows?
item.description: Compare scalar captures with per-match rows and check source identity in PostgreSQL.

item.title: Why did narrowing pytest’s conftest boundary hide a fixture?
item.description: Change pytest's conftest boundary while keeping the test file fixed, then use collection and fixture setup to locate a missing definition.

item.title: Why does introspection see a wrapper that forwards every argument?
item.description: Compare forwarded calls and signature inspection in one Python runtime fixture.

item.title: Why can’t you zip as_completed results back to the original inputs?
item.description: Use a gated thread-pool run to distinguish completion order from input identity.

item.title: Why can a reader still see an empty file after copyfileobj returns?
item.description: Compare two executed reads around a buffered Python file-copy handoff.

item.title: Why can a bound method keep a weakref.finalize target alive?
item.description: Compare two executed CPython registrations to see how a callback can retain its own target.

item.title: Why can Redis SMOVE succeed without growing the destination?
item.description: Compare two successful moves that have different effects on destination cardinality.

item.title: Why does a missing file skip one systemd unit but fail another start?
item.description: Check the same path in two systemd units and distinguish a condition skip, an assertion failure, and actual execution.

item.title: When should aria-busy end during a two-step update?
item.description: Use a two-step inventory update to locate the busy window and distinguish DOM checks from assistive technology observations.

item.title: Why did a BuildKit multi-platform export add another directory level?
item.description: Compare BuildKit local exporter layouts using a distinct marker for each target platform.

item.title: Why can a CMake installation break after its directory moves?
item.description: Compare copied and relative-symlink CMake installations, then check both after moving their install trees.

item.title: Can text-wrap: balance add a line to a short heading?
item.description: Compare ordinary and balanced wrapping on headings with identical text and width. Test the short-heading line-count rule in the CSS Text 4 draft.

item.title: Why is a blank required input invalid before it is user-invalid?
item.description: A blank required input can be invalid before a submit attempt. Read both selectors before submission, after failure, and after correction.

item.title: How do you read Git blame past a formatting commit?
item.description: Compare attribution on an unchanged file before and after explicitly ignoring a mechanical Git revision.

item.title: Does a false return from Go AfterFunc’s stop mean cleanup finished?
item.description: Separate Go AfterFunc cancellation, stopping, and callback completion with two channel-based controls.

item.title: Why can’t Go Rows.Next returning false certify a complete result?
item.description: Use an identical row prefix to distinguish normal completion from a terminal Go database/sql error.

item.title: Is HTTP 203 a failure? Check the response’s transforming proxy
item.description: Compare an origin catalog with a 200 response and a transformed view with a 203 response. Keep the request path when interpreting or validating the delivered content.

item.title: What should you reduce after HTTP 431?
item.description: A smaller body can still get 431. Use a fictional header budget to distinguish a single oversized field from an oversized set and see what the client can change.

item.title: How do you insert a dollar-sign label literally with replaceAll?
item.description: Compare a replacement string and a replacement function using the same dollar-sign label. Verify both template slots with exact output assertions.

item.title: When does Kubernetes start the TTL for a finished Job?
item.description: Calculate the eligibility time from two terminal Job states and preserve evidence before Kubernetes cleanup.

item.title: Why does Map.groupBy split objects that share a name?
item.description: Group the same three tickets by object reference and by name. Verify membership and check what happens when a new object looks identical to an existing key.

item.title: Why can the second bad value fail a PostgreSQL COPY that skips errors?
item.description: Use two PostgreSQL COPY inputs to separate a tolerated conversion error from an exceeded rejection budget.

item.title: Why can pytest pass with a misspelled configuration key?
item.description: Hold the test fixed while checking pytest’s warning, strict failure, and repaired result for an unknown configuration key.

item.title: Why is a heapq.merge result still out of order?
item.description: Use a two-stream Python fixture to check the merge precondition and its failure boundary.

item.title: Why does a mock assertion see a dictionary after it was cleared?
item.description: Compare an actual mock call reference with a separate snapshot taken before mutation.

item.title: Why doesn’t singledispatch choose a handler from the second argument?
item.description: Trace first-argument selection and the default path in four executed Python calls.

item.title: Why doesn’t SMISMEMBER return the member names?
item.description: Use mixed and repeated requests to check positional Redis membership replies.

item.title: Why did systemd stop the shared service after its last consumer stopped?
item.description: Use two systemd consumers to reason about when a shared service stays active and when it can stop automatically.
